tagline: An investment record you can trace.
loginHint: Use the owner account initialized on your host.
expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
failed: The request failed. Check the details and try again.
name: Name
sourceHint: Order dates are not wallet confirmations. Missing files do not mean no new activity.
frozen: A saved observation, not a live quote.
noReportHint: Upload a supported CSV or enter a dated BTC total. Preview it before confirming.
noPortfolios: Create a private portfolio to begin.
nativeHint: Original-currency securities exclude the CAD-valued BTC proxy. Bitcoin is shown separately.
growthHint: Value changes include deposits, withdrawals and market moves. They are not investment returns.
onePoint: One observation so far. More dated snapshots will build this history.
companyHint: Weight uses the whole portfolio, including cash. Unresolved ETF constituents remain unclassified.
noExposure: No resolved company exposure in this observation. See the downloaded report for unresolved holdings.
noBtc: No Bitcoin observation in this report.
btcHint: BTC and LBTC are tracked as BTC equivalent. Funding and purchase spend must not be counted twice as contributions.
noFlows: No cash flows recorded. This does not establish zero contributions.
uploadHint: Use either supported CSV, both, or an optional dated BTC total. Nothing is imported until you confirm a ready preview.
openingHint: First Bull import needs an explicit opening declaration. Use the documented JSON schema.
confirmHint: This commits the confirmed inputs and generates reports. Existing history is retained.
noJobs: No jobs yet. Start with a preview.
previewHint: A preview does not commit financial facts. Review its saved source dates and checks; reference retrieval follows the explicitly selected preparation policy.
workerHint: Background processing uses the instance worker. Leaving this page does not cancel the job.
policyHint: The proxy estimates unknown acquisition costs; it does not establish actual historical costs.
saved: Settings saved. Existing reports are unchanged.
passwordHint: Changing the password ends all sessions.
maintenance: Use Financial records for BTC events and contributions. Existing-ledger adoption remains a trusted-host CLI operation.
error.stale_preview: Inputs changed. Create a new preview.
error.stale_engine: The application changed. Create a new preview.
error.preview_unavailable: Preview is blocked or expired. Create a new one.
error.portfolio_busy: Resolve the existing update before starting another.
error.invalid_upload: Check the file format, encoding and limits.
error.body_too_large: The file is too large. Check the documented limits.
error.upload_integrity: Stored evidence changed. Upload the correct file and preview again.
error.report_integrity: Report integrity needs local review. Do not reimport to guess the result.
error.invalid_request: Check the required fields and timestamp offsets.
error.authentication_required: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
error.logout_failed: Sign-out could not be confirmed. Retry sign-out before leaving a shared device.
status.opening_plus_orders_unadjusted_fo: Opening plus purchases; wallet fees not supplied
exportScope: Exports use this saved report. Missing values stay unknown; this is not a full backup. Date limits are inclusive; BTC monthly limits include whole months.
error.maintenance: Maintenance is in progress. Retry shortly.
error.export_too_large: The export exceeds its limit or the bundle is incomplete. Download individual files or review on the host.
error.invalid_export_range: Check the date range and choose a dated dataset.
recordsHint: Save dated evidence, review discrepancies, and retain every revision. Saving data leaves published reports unchanged.
recordTask: What would you like to record?
recordRevision: Correct, void or link a BTC record
openingReferenceAt: Total observation time with UTC offset
openingBasis: Why this difference is pre-tracking holdings
linkedBalance: Balance to explain (optional for new events)
purchasedQuantity: Recorded acquisition quantity at reference time
recordSavedHint: Data saved. Review current records, then prepare a new report to include these changes.
recordConfirmHint: Save this reviewed declaration to the selected ledger. Previous revisions and published reports remain available. No prices or reports are generated by this step.
noRecords: No records yet. Add evidence above when available.
recordsTruncated: This page shows up to 1,000 records per category. The complete history remains in your ledger and backups.
renderSaved: Prepare a report from saved data (no new CSV required)
balanceDeclarationHint: Use the total BTC + LBTC equivalent across all tracked wallets. Enter a timestamp with UTC offset. A difference remains unexplained until you provide dated evidence; it is never automatically classified as a fee or contribution.
openingDeclarationHint: Requires imported acquisition records. Freezes total minus known net purchases and applicable events as pre-tracking BTC quantity, with unknown actual cost. New balance observations do not recalculate it.
flowDeclarationHint: Record actual cash movements, not holdings growth or purchase spend. USD requires dated FX evidence or an explicit sourced CAD value. Transfers need a shared pairing reference. CSV columns: date, account_id, flow_type, currency, amount; optional flow_id, transfer_id, usd_cad, amount_cad, fx_date, fx_source.
coverageDeclarationHint: Declare complete only after checking all external brokerage flows in (start, end]. This does not establish Bull funding origins or combined-portfolio return eligibility. Later declarations are retained.
revisionDeclarationHint: Select an active record and action. Corrections require the displayed revision and a reason. Identity changes require voiding and an explicit replacement; link events to the balance interval they explain.
error.request_rejected: The declaration could not be accepted. Review current records, dates, references and required fields, then run a fresh preview.
error.preview_failed: The declaration could not be accepted. Review current records, dates, references and required fields, then run a fresh preview.
error.commit_state_requires_review: The declaration could not be accepted. Review current records, dates, references and required fields, then run a fresh preview.
status.ledger_conflict: Opening or source overlap needs review
migrationVerification: Verified at migration. Original publication checksums were unavailable; historical authenticity is not established.
knownEventsAtReference: Known net events at reference time (BTC)
observedSubtotalHint: These values cover valued observed holdings, not complete wealth. Missing contributions and full portfolio returns remain unknown.
sourceApprovalHint: Review each source account and destination. Confirmation binds these mappings, observed totals and explicit valuation references.
sourceMappingRequired: Account choices are incomplete. Submit a new source preview with reviewed bindings before confirming.
parserModeHint: Default import workflow: detect enabled parsers, review account mappings and confirm exact inputs. Reuse a saved source context explicitly when appropriate. No CSV means saved facts only; purchase history does not prove wallet balances.
fetchPublicReferences: Fetch public dated FX/BTC references before approval
referencesRequired: References are missing. Supply JSON or explicitly allow public reference retrieval.
correctionContextHint: Provide explicit record and scope parent revisions. Parents are never guessed or carried from a saved context. Review a new preview before confirming.
contextLoadFailed: Saved source contexts could not be verified. Retry or review the ledger evidence.
reportHistoryHint: Each group shares a valuation cutoff and tracked scope. Earlier editions are preserved; editions are not additional imports or observations.
reportLanguageHint: The document and downloads retain their published language. Interface controls do not rewrite the report.
savedDocumentHint: This document reads the saved report. Values, wording and charts retain this edition’s cutoff and assumptions.
documentUnavailableHint: Downloads remain available. This edition may not contain a supported saved Markdown document.
savedChartUnavailable: This chart was not saved as a registered attachment.
createPortfolioHint: Choose a name for this independent ledger. Creating it does not import accounts, transactions or sample investments.
startIntro: Your portfolio is ready for data. No report has been published yet; this does not mean your investments are worth zero.
startChooseBody: Add a supported bank or broker CSV. The built-in formats are Wealthsimple holdings and Bull Bitcoin orders; either can be used alone or together. A dated BTC total can also be provided on its own.
startReviewBody: Choose Baseline for your first observation. Review source dates, account destinations and missing information. Uploading and previewing do not book financial records.
startPublishBody: Confirm a ready preview, then wait for the worker to publish the report. Analysis reports will show the saved analysis and downloads in PDF, ODS and Markdown.
startExportsBody: Use the original CSV, not a screenshot. Holdings exports provide positions at a date; order exports provide recorded activity. Neither proves complete contribution history or wallet balances. Other formats require an installed, enabled compatible parser.
startContextBody: If requested, supply a stable account alias and the source timezone. Keep the same alias for later exports of the same source account. Account destinations are reviewed before confirmation.
startReferencesBody: If the preview needs FX or BTC prices, provide verified reference JSON or explicitly allow public reference fetching. A missing reference needs a new ready preview; opening this page fetches no market data.
startHistoryBody: Add future exports when available. One observation starts the history; gaps between uploads are not filled with invented month-end balances. Missing files never mean no new transactions.
startFlowsBody: Record deposits, withdrawals, transfers and coverage when you have evidence. Missing earlier costs and contributions stay unknown. You can start with holdings and add those records later; purchase spend is not automatically a contribution.
evidenceStatusHint: Review the supplied evidence and its limits. These checks do not confirm complete wealth or independently verify a wallet.
evidenceHistorical: Historical edition; current jobs are separate
evidenceDatesUnknown: Some source dates are unavailable. The report cutoff does not establish their observation dates.
evidenceDatesDiffer: Sources have different dates and meanings. Compare snapshot, order and observation dates before interpreting the total.
evidenceCarriedBody: This edition explicitly carries source data forward. No new file does not establish no activity.
evidenceScopeBody: The saved values cover supplied observations, not a confirmation of complete wealth.
evidenceBtcBlocked: Saved evidence blocks BTC valuation. Review the relevant declarations and checks before publishing another edition.
evidenceBtcUnknown: The quantity or its basis is unavailable in this saved view. Do not infer a wallet balance from purchases.
evidenceBtcDeclared: A user-reported total is recorded. This is a declaration, not independent wallet verification or proof that earlier gaps are resolved.
evidenceBtcEstimated: BTC quantity is estimated from saved ledger evidence. It does not establish a current wallet balance or complete fee coverage.
evidenceCostUnknown: Complete acquisition cost is unavailable in this saved view. Purchase spending and proxy estimates are not full actual cost.
evidenceFlowsUnknown: This saved view does not establish complete cash-flow coverage or eligible full-portfolio period returns. Recorded flows and purchases alone are insufficient.
evidenceCheckBody: Review the saved notice and its affected context. A check is not a new financial observation.
evidenceGapUnavailable: A numeric BTC reconciliation gap is not exposed by this saved view. Unavailable does not mean zero or resolved; review the original report evidence.
processingHint: Live job state is separate from the selected saved edition. Processing does not update its saved amounts.
processingUnavailable: Current job state is unavailable. The saved report remains readable.
processingHostReview: Review this advanced job on the trusted host.
processingJobMissing: The requested job is not in the available scoped job list. No other job has been selected.
importInputOptions: Use either supported CSV, both, a dated BTC total alone, or saved facts. Missing files do not establish no new activity.
importContextHint: Reuse a verified saved context when available. Keep the same account alias for the same source account across exports. Supply the source timezone for timestamps without an offset; filenames and upload time are not observation evidence.
importTimingHint: Use explicit UTC offsets for entered dates. A BTC total needs its observation time; it establishes quantity, not purchase cost or a contribution. A valuation cutoff does not replace source dates.
importCompatibilityHint: Parser mode is the normal workflow. Native compatibility is for existing native ledgers and cannot omit canonical source facts. Changing mode requires a new preview.
importReferenceHint: Saved or uploaded references keep preparation offline. Fetch public references is a separate, explicit choice that may access official services and save reference caches; it never books financial facts. Native confirmation may fetch missing references under its existing contract.
importDraftHint: Preview does not approve an import. Unsent fields and file selections stay in this tab after errors; they are not stored in browser storage. Retry unchanged requests before editing when the network outcome is uncertain.
importDraftChanged: Inputs changed. Create and review a new preview before confirming. The old preview remains historical evidence.
importFrozenReviewHint: Confirmation uses this saved preview and its exact reviewed inputs. Unsent form edits are never silently included. Review mappings, source dates, scope, totals and pending checks before confirming.
importPublished: Report published. Open the saved edition to review its analysis and downloads.
importCommitted: Data is saved; the report is not published yet. Wait for the worker. Cancelling or reimporting does not undo this commit.
importReportFailed: Data is saved but report creation failed. Resume the same saved report using its original inputs and cutoff; do not import the CSV again to recover it.
importLocalReview: This job needs trusted-host review. Its outcome must not be guessed. Preserve evidence and stop automatic retries; do not reimport to resolve an uncertain commit.
importCancelled: The queued job was cancelled. Earlier ledger history remains. Prepare a fresh preview when ready; cancellation never reverses committed data.
importWaiting: Waiting for the worker or processing saved inputs. Do not submit another financial update to speed this up.
importCorrectPreview: The preview cannot be confirmed. Review the error and blocking checks, correct the inputs, then create a new preview.
importMapNext: Review each source account destination, then choose Preview reviewed mappings. Suggestions are not approval.
importReferencesNext: References are missing. Open the reference options below, supply the named JSON files or explicitly choose a public fetch, then preview again.
importReady: Preview ready for review. This state alone does not establish whether linked formal work already ran; check saved job outcomes. Confirmation is a separate action.
importUnknownOutcome: The outcome is not established by this job view. Preserve the job ID and evidence for trusted-host review; do not guess a retry or reimport.
importRecoveryGuideBody: Stop workers and other writers; preserve a complete private backup. Inspect the job operation and report evidence with the documented host tools. Do not edit database states, delete guards or force a retry when commit evidence is unproven.
importReviewDraft: Review inputs for a new preview
importStaleHint: The saved approval is no longer current. Close this review, check the inputs and create a new preview; do not reuse the old approval.
importRetryHint: If the network result is uncertain, keep the draft unchanged and inspect this job first. An unchanged retry reuses its request identity; a saved-data report failure uses Resume saved report.
importPreviewIdentity: Saved job identity and technical details
importContextErrorHint: Check the selected source context, stable account alias, timezone and advanced parser/correction options, then preview the corrected inputs.
importErrorReviewHint: Review the error code and the saved job outcome. Correct a nonbooking preview as needed; a proven commit uses report recovery, and an unproven outcome needs trusted-host review.
importLinkedJob: This preview already has a formal job. Inspect that saved outcome instead of starting another import.
importBlockedByJob: Another financial job is unfinished. Resolve its saved outcome before confirming a new update. Creating a preview remains nonbooking.
importSelectedJobHint: This panel shows a previously saved job. New draft inputs above do not change its outcome.
chartScrollHint: Scroll to see every country. Keyboard: focus the chart, then use Arrow keys, Page Up / Down or Home / End. Exact values are in View chart data below.
chartUnavailable: The chart could not be displayed. Open View chart data below for the complete distribution.
